messages:
emily.b: Heads up — billing reported a ~12% delta between invoices for July 1-2 and the dashboard token totals. Looks like tokens were undercounted during a metering outage window. Anyone saw alerts?

billing_bot: [auto] Invoice export job finished for 2026-07-02 09:15 UTC. Total tokens=9,120,432.

maria: saw a spike in ingestion lag around 2026-07-01 03:40 UTC, Kafka consumer for metering-events had repeated backpressure.

jamal: confirm — replay queue accumulated ~1.2M events. replayer crashed on checkpoint write at 03:48. Error: `IOError: failed to persist offset`

ops-bot: deploy #replayer v2.4.1 -> prod succeeded (03:55 UTC) :rocket:

sre_oncall: replayer restart fixed processing, but backlog was processed with a `--fast-mode` path that drops debug metadata. That might affect tokenization accounting.

kevin: tokenizer changes from the July 1 can cause different token counts if we re-encoded stored prompts. Any chance the replay used a different tokenizer version?

data-eng: we run replay on raw events; tokenizer is applied at metering stage. The bug was in the metering consumer using the env var `TOKENIZER=v2` fallback to `v1` after crash. So some events were tokenized with v1, others with v2.

support_lead: Customer-facing impact — we have 4 escalations claiming invoices higher than dashboard showed. Need a reconciliation and a remediation path ASAP.

emily.b: Action plan suggestion: (1) confirm exact event window and affected customer IDs, (2) run a deterministic re-tokenization on canonical payloads for affected window, (3) produce a delta ledger and bill adjustments if > $X, (4) fix replayer checkpointing and add unit test.

jamal: I'll extract the window. Running quick query to find earliest lag and last processed offsets.

jamal: query run: `SELECT MIN(ts), MAX(ts) FROM metering_offsets WHERE state='stalled' AND date='2026-07-01'` -> 2026-07-01T03:42:10Z to 2026-07-01T03:58:34Z

maria: flagged the 03:42–03:58 window. I'll dump list of affected customer_ids to s3: `s3://redwood-metering/backfill/2026-07-01-window/customers-20260701.csv`

data-eng: Before a full backfill: run replayer in dry-run to compute token deltas per customer. Command: 
```
events_replay --from 2026-07-01T03:42:00Z --to 2026-07-01T03:59:00Z \
  --mode dry-run --tokenizer v2 --output s3://redwood-metering/backfill/dry-run-deltas.json
```

kevin: dry-run will surface the per-cust delta. Also add `--preserve-order` to avoid any race-induced diffs.

ops-bot: alert resolved: replayer memory leak fixed in v2.4.1.

billing_bot: [export] Dashboard daily-aggregate (2026-07-01) tokens=10,345,678; Invoice exported tokens=9,120,432

emily.b: That invoice vs dashboard gap is ~1.2M tokens. If dry-run shows similar, we should prepare pro-rated credits and a short customer note.

support_lead: please prepare standard credit template. Legal review not needed for under $5k per account (per policy).

jamal: dry-run finished, uploading results. Summary: total delta +1,187,241 tokens. Per-customer sample: cust_342: +12,421, cust_912: +98,003, cust_881: +0 (no diff)

data-eng: root cause: replayer crashed while writing checkpoint, restart used legacy env. Fix: 1) enforce immutable runtime config for replayer, 2) atomic checkpoint writes, 3) add integration test that simulates IOException at checkpoint write.

maria: starting real backfill now with `--tokenizer v2 --skip-fast-path` and `--preserve-order`. Will run in small batches and reconcile after each batch.

maria: backfill command: 
```
events_replay --from 2026-07-01T03:42:00Z --to 2026-07-01T03:59:00Z \
  --mode replay --tokenizer v2 --preserve-order --batch-size 50k \
  --output s3://redwood-metering/backfill/results/20260701/
```

kevin: also push a small patch to metering-consumer to log tokenizer version in metrics so we can alert on mismatches.

emily.b: Who's owning customer comms?

support_lead: I will send initial note to affected customers by EOD once we confirm deltas and credit amounts. Template ready.

sre_oncall: follow-up: added playbook entry -> `incidents/metering/replayer-checkpointing.md` and turned on an SLO alert for checkpoint write latency.

emily.b: Thanks everyone. Leave this thread open for post-backfill verification. We'll update once invoices are adjusted and support sends comms. :white_check_mark:
